guidance.visualLanguage: Dense calm charcoal editor with purple-gray layers, thin decorative separators, restrained 8px fields/buttons and 10px panels, lavender selection/focus, dusty pink primary actions, modest typographic hierarchy, flat inner rows
guidance.responsive: Keep shrinkable tracks and existing reading order. Technical badges keep intrinsic width and never break within identifiers. The reference Margin notes gutter grows intrinsically and stacks at a font-relative threshold. Phone panels use12px padding normally; at320px enlarged text, font-relative clamps recover horizontal panel/notice reading space. Only direct arrow/mode buttons are sticky.
guidance.state: Version the reference appearance separately. Retain legacy style IDs, raw backup and both prior refinements. Apply the new explicit request once only to fresh/matching selected04; retain unrelated and all later choices. Browsing/confirmation/elimination/restoration never changes the palette.
guidance.QA: Inspect actual1440/390/320 dark/light pixels at100/200text. Verify typography, focus, meaningful boundaries, source-color restrictions, state/export parity, and palette persistence before publishing.
guidance.optionalReadingBases: Existing explicit reading-base overrides are secondary. The dark Neutral raised fill requires main ink for proposal text; source-muted-to-neutral-raised remains an honestly reported restricted pair.
